title: The Caretaker - Everywhere At The End Of Time - Stages 1-6 (Complete)
summary: The complete six-stage album series Everywhere at the End of Time by The Caretaker, about 6.5 hours of music that depicts the progression of dementia through distorted, decaying old ballroom recordings.
why: HN recommends it, often emotionally, as an auditory depiction of memory loss, in threads about dementia and aging.

quote.text: It's haunting and beautiful and quite memorable.
